description: Mixed Water Supply is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Calderdale Metropolitan Borough Council. Mixed water supply areas in Calderdale, saved as a.TAB file in a compressed (zipped) format. These files contains the shape, extent and location of mixed water supplies. Further infromation can be found at:. Coverage: Calderdale Metropolitan Borough Council. The portal files it under the publisher Calderdale Metropolitan Borough Council. The portal shows 2026-07-08 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is UK Open Government Licence (OGL). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
